original_target.title: A finite-integrability ABP estimate for general nonlocal Pucci operators
original_target.area: Fully nonlinear nonlocal PDEs; maximum principles
original_target.outcome: Claim: negative for every strict ellipticity pair, claimed

answer: Negative for every strict pair0<lambda<Lambda; linear equality case is not a counterexample.
required_status_qualification: Solved on the basis of an unverified announcement. The full target is claimed in the cited source; the external proof has not been independently verified here.
scope_comparison: For n>=1,0<sigma<2 and every0<lambda<Lambda, the source constructs a fixed even kernel coefficient a between lambda,Lambda, smooth compactly supported u_j>=0,f_j>=0 in B1, f_j<=1 and support measure->0, with L_a u_j>=-f_j while u_j>=d>0 on B1/4. Set sigma=2s. Pointwise Pucci maximality gives original M+u_j>=(1/2)L_a u_j>=-f_j/2. Thus original continuous right side f=-f_j/2 has sup norm<=1, every finite Lp norm->0, and any positive-power proposed bound fails. Smooth classical functions satisfy the specified viscosity convention. The universal family is refuted for all strict ellipticity pairs; lambda=Lambda is the standard linear fractional Laplacian case and is not claimed negative.
